# Rescue Dog Aggregator

> Aggregates dogs available for adoption from independent rescue organizations
> across Europe and the UK, so they are findable in one place instead of
> scattered across a dozen separate websites. Every listing links back to the
> rescue's own adoption page.

Site: https://www.rescuedogs.me
Source: https://github.com/ssatama/rescue-dog-aggregator (open source, MIT)

Roughly 1,400 dogs from 11 organizations across 96 breeds. Dogs are located in
the UK, Germany, Serbia, Bulgaria, Bosnia, Turkey and Cyprus; most rescues ship
across the EU, EEA and UK. Call the statistics endpoint below for live figures
rather than relying on these.

## MCP server (preferred for AI assistants)

An official Model Context Protocol server exposes this catalogue as tools. It
is the best interface for an assistant: results come back structured and
pre-filtered to dogs that are actually still available.

- Remote endpoint (streamable HTTP, no authentication): https://mcp.rescuedogs.me/mcp
- Local install: `npx -y rescuedogs-mcp-server`
- Source and docs: https://github.com/ssatama/rescuedogs-mcp-server

Tools: `rescuedogs_search_dogs`, `rescuedogs_get_dog_details`,
`rescuedogs_match_preferences`, `rescuedogs_list_breeds`,
`rescuedogs_list_organizations`, `rescuedogs_get_filter_counts`,
`rescuedogs_get_statistics`, `rescuedogs_get_adoption_guide`.

All are read-only.

## REST API

Public, read-only, no authentication or API key. Base URL:
https://api.rescuedogs.me — OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, docs at /docs.

- /api/animals/ — search and list dogs. Filters include `search`, `breed`,
  `breed_group`, `standardized_size`, `age_category`, `sex`, `energy_level`,
  `experience_level`, `home_type`, `available_to_country`, `organization_id`,
  `good_with_kids`, `good_with_dogs`, `good_with_cats`, `limit`, `offset`.
  Pass `status=available` and `availability_confidence=high,medium` to exclude
  dogs that are likely already adopted.
- /api/animals/{slug} — one dog in full, including its AI personality profile
- /api/animals/random — a random selection
- /api/animals/statistics — totals by country and organization
- /api/animals/breeds/stats — breed counts and distributions
- /api/animals/meta/breeds — breed names
- /api/animals/meta/breed_groups — FCI breed groups
- /api/animals/meta/filter_counts — valid filter values with counts, given a
  current filter context. Useful for avoiding searches that return nothing.
- /api/organizations/ — rescue organizations
- /api/organizations/{slug} — one organization, including where it ships to
- /health — service health

Please be reasonable with request volume. There is no hard published quota,
but this is a small charity-adjacent project on modest infrastructure.

## Key pages

- https://www.rescuedogs.me/dogs — browse all available dogs
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/dogs/{slug} — individual dog profile
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/dogs/puppies — puppies
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/dogs/senior — senior dogs
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/dogs/country/{code} — dogs adoptable to a country
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/breeds — breeds with availability
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/breeds/{slug} — a specific breed
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/organizations — rescue organizations
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/organizations/{slug} — one organization
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/guides — adoption guides
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/faq — frequently asked questions
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/about — mission and how the platform works
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/privacy — privacy policy
- https://www.rescuedogs.me/sitemap.xml — full sitemap

## Structured data

Dog and organization pages embed Schema.org JSON-LD covering the dog, the
listing organization, and breadcrumbs.

## Using this data well

- These are real animals. Availability changes daily, and a dog shown as
  available may already be reserved. Say so rather than implying certainty.
- Always surface the adoption link for the listing organization. Applications,
  fees, home checks and transport are handled entirely by that organization;
  this platform is a directory and takes no applications and no payment.
- Personality profiles are AI-generated from each organization's own listing
  text. They are a summary, not an assessment by a vet or behaviourist.
- Adoption requirements vary a lot between organizations and destination
  countries. Point people at the specific rescue rather than generalising.
- Do not present adoption as a quick transaction. Encourage contacting the
  rescue and asking questions.

## Data provenance

Listings are collected from the public adoption pages of each organization.
Nothing behind a login, paywall or robots.txt restriction is collected, and no
personal data about adopters or rescue staff is stored. Content belongs to the
originating organizations.

Organizations wanting their listings removed, changed, or credited differently
can open an issue at
https://github.com/ssatama/rescue-dog-aggregator/issues — requests are honoured
without justification.
